details:
Recently I've noticed that marking any world as "preloaded" and also actually preloading a world, then joining it, actually improves Load times by about 2-10 seconds instead of just normally loading the world.

depending on world size, those few seconds are actually REALLY nice to see.

(Edit: Ive noticed that on Desktop Mode, this "bug" is not a thing, but on VR mode, it does the things I explain below)

My only thought would be, can we make this better for everyone, being PC and Android. (please correct me if I'm wrong at ANY point devs)

Interesting enough, if you want to reproduce this yourself, just load into a world you already have Downloaded on your drive, note how long it takes, then if youd like to use the same world you can, press the "preload" button, and join an instance again.

I think the main reason why it seems like its faster, is cause VRC has to load the "Downloading World Environment" and then also display the loading progress, de-load all the assets for that, then load into the world.

I think there should be some way, to make sure that if you already have a world loaded on your disk, that you shouldn't have to press "preload" and would already say "Clear Preload". Because the "preload" stays even after a restart of the client, it would improve load times, and also remove a little stress on a device when having to go into that "Downloading World" environment, deload all the assets from the "Downloading World" screen, then load the ACTUAL world assets, just seems like a weird extra loading thing is you already HAVE the world loaded if you ask me.

This could also be implemented with worlds ALREADY loaded on your device as well... (Assuming your device has the latest Update to the world), it would basically remove the "Downloading World" Screen for already downloaded worlds, but still pop up if a user has not downloaded the world and continue from there.

This part is more of a feature request, but what would be REALLY nice, is an Asset Management Tab.

To sum it up, basically a new tab, ether in settings, or an actual tab on the big menu, where all Downloaded Worlds and User Uploaded (Private/Public) Avatars *not private other users uploaded avatars, but include the local Users Private/Public Avatars*, and be able to download/delete the file from your cashe without having to clear the ENTIRE thing...

Or have it separated into, Worlds, Avatars, Delete Other-Delete Everything (Just incase we DO want to keep everything.) 

This would be nice in SEVERAL ways, 

1: a user could actually DELETE an avatar from their local device, to save space if they need to, (even tho the custom limit of the cashe can be shortened on PC, on Quest it can't)

2: it would be the same for Worlds, if a world you went to recently was really garbage and just a bunch of high texture bloat, you could instantly remove it from your pc (Like how you can CLEAR a preload)

3: it would give a bit more information on how much space avatars/worlds take up, *maybe include VRAM for the avatars section :>

4: it can also save your butt if you like to world hop, and you reach the limit of 20~ worlds in the "Recent Worlds" tab, you could go back to the World in your Asset Management Tab and be able to find the world again

5: (A little far fetched) and HOPEFULLY something people WOULD NOT be able to do, is backwards rip the assets labeled in the Asset Manager Tab. 

Being able to all the worlds/avatars seen on your device would prob tickle the fancy of Rippers and bad client users and such, so unless there's some sort of encryption with the new Avatar Ghost/whatever feature that was said in the beta, we might want to do this for worlds too. We would also want to make sure that the assets can only be deleted from the VRC Tab.

I do understand that cashe system deletes worlds/avatars/assets that are un-used after a certain time, however, sometimes, its just nice to have it to where you have a little control over when its deleted, and not waiting several days for it to delete OR for you to load several worlds for it to clear out finally...

I have a slight vision for how the tab could be created, so let me know what you guys think, and what other benefits this feature could add, or any negatives this might cause.
title: World Preloading (Bug/Feature) Possible Fix + Feature Request
